author: original (script-authored in Blender via the pinned Blender MCP bridge)
notes: Soul: floating hollow mask with inward-curling crescent horns (soul_glow, saturated cyan, emissive 1.2) and open almond eye holes, tipped 30 deg up toward the game camera, over a curling teardrop wisp plus three motes (soul_core, pale, emissive 0.6) that reaches down to the ground point. Cyan (cool) vs the courier ivory (warm) keeps body and soul apart even at a few pixels. Deliberately no body/limbs so it never reads as a second courier. Origin on the ground; mask pivot at z 0.64, wisp pivot just under and behind the chin for runtime sway; the wisp tip touches the ground at the true soul position. Holes are real geometry (scanfill + solidify), so bolts and floor show through the eyes.
